review.rationale: The mutation replaces a conditional check `if snapshot.digest_algorithm != DIGEST_ALGORITHM:` with `if False:`, permanently disabling the branch. In the original code, when `snapshot.digest_algorithm` differs from `DIGEST_ALGORITHM`, the branch body executes (presumably raising an error, logging, or taking corrective action). With `if False:`, that branch body never executes regardless of the actual digest algorithm value. This produces an observable behavioral difference: mismatched digest algorithms will no longer trigger the guarded behavior, allowing execution to proceed past the check unconditionally.
